sourceChange: Capture fixed-label original PID, exact executable/UID501 and all metrics listener owners before bootout. Wait at most 90 seconds for both original process disappearance and metrics release; verify maintenance ownership every iteration and fail on unrelated owners or reloaded service. No signal/force-kill fallback. Recovery refuses duplicate Tunnel while the original still exits; system-to-GUI rollback uses the same exit guard.
